verified_facts.text: Rooms feature high ceilings, aged oak floors and Carrara marble bathrooms with oversized rain showers.

verified_facts.text: The Turret Penthouse is a duplex with a private terrace, 40-foot ceilings and a stone fireplace in the building's turret.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relish a hotel stay where aged oak floors, a separate living and dining area, 40-foot ceilings, curated artwork and a stone fireplace offer lavish residential comforts in a centuries-old turret.

verified_facts.text: Temple Court serves a menu of classics reimagined by chef Tom Colicchio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us at Temple Court where a menu of classics, old and new, are reimagined by acclaimed chef Tom Colicchio, with his signature, seasonal touch.

verified_facts.text: The Bar Room sits beneath the pyramidal atrium skylight and serves an all-day menu by Tom Colicchio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ornamental Victorian wrought-iron railings catch the light pouring in from the pyramidal atrium skylight above The Bar Room.

verified_facts.text: Le Gratin is Daniel Boulud's Bouchon Lyonnais inspired by his hometown of Lyon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef Daniel Boulud introduces Le Gratin, a Bouchon Lyonnais located in The Beekman, a Thompson Hotel in the heart of Lower Manhattan.

verified_facts.text: Laissez Faire is a cocktail lounge on the hotel's cellar level where DJs play later in the night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Laissez Faire is a high-end, bespoke cocktail lounge located at 10 Theatre Alley, on the cellar level of The Beekman, a Thompson Hotel.

verified_facts.text: Laissez Faire hosts jazz on Wednesday nights with a rotating cast of the city's jazz musicians.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring a rotating cadre of the city’s most talented jazz musicians, enjoy a martini and a variety of delectable bites.
